acceptance.assertion: Only complete verified canonical route_evidence with route schema v2 and actual_route=direct_operator is eligible; unbound tasks, workspace routes, external candidates and reconstructed argv-based routing truth are rejected before task launch.

The direct-task case is frozen after final bounded command identity is known but before resource lease acquisition, task-store insertion or process launch, so later completion or failure cannot influence inclusion.
Only the internal direct-task prestart path can emit production provenance with source direct-task-start; public or synthetic direct capture cannot self-assert production and remains quarantined.

A versioned create-only direct-task binding stores only bounded route features and hashes of host, argv, cwd and resource scope; it excludes raw argv, prompts, transcripts, environment values, private notes and unrestricted paths.
Capture failure is reported but never blocks the durable task, and every artifact remains proposal-only with routing, policy, queue, merge, deploy and runtime effects false.

A separate mutating seal operation requires authoritative terminal task readback, compatible execution-failure provenance and independent reviewed semantic evidence or explicit abstention; lifecycle success alone cannot create a positive label.

Identical retries converge on the first create-only binding while changing attempt receipts cannot alter binding identity; conflicting duplicates, lineage drift, symlink traversal and invalid schemas fail closed.

Schemas, public tool contracts, generated context, focused regressions and full validation pass on the exact reviewed diff; the merged runtime is deployed and one genuine no-effect direct-task pilot is prospectively captured and conservatively sealed or left explicitly unsealed.

goal: Extend the existing no-effect routing-shadow cohort to explicitly routed direct Grabowski durable tasks so natural operator work can be frozen prospectively before launch and sealed only after terminal evidence, without reconstructing routes, storing raw private execution inputs or granting routing or training authority.

metadata.source: Live learning-layer audit and user implementation request on 2026-07-24
metadata.verification_note: PR #448 introduced prospective direct-task routing-shadow capture and terminal sealing; post-merge review found retry-timestamp and reviewed-outcome evidence defects, corrected by PR #452. Both are merged, the exact corrective merge is deployed with a complete 174/174 runtime contract, and one genuine R0 no-effect direct task was frozen before launch, completed, conservatively sealed as abstained, and replayed later as a duplicate retaining the first binding identity. This verifies T006 only; one pilot does not establish cohort sufficiency, representativeness, T004 PASS or ML training readiness.

validated_acceptance.canonical-direct-route-only: The deployed start path accepts only normalized schema-v2 route evidence with actual_route=direct_operator, verified and evidence_complete; the live pilot used the canonical R0 direct route recommendation and no external candidates.
validated_acceptance.prospective-prelaunch-freeze: The pilot prospective receipt was created at 2026-07-24T20:14:19.296977Z before terminal execution observation and before outcome sealing; task start returned the capture receipt alongside the launcher receipt.
validated_acceptance.internal-production-provenance: The stored prospective receipt identifies source direct-task-start, capture_path direct_task_prestart and case_origin production; untrusted direct capture remains quarantined by the reviewed implementation and tests.
validated_acceptance.privacy-bounded-create-only-binding: The stored binding contains only bounded route features and SHA-256 identities for host, argv, cwd and resource scope; raw execution values are absent. The binding artifact is create-only and hash-verified.
validated_acceptance.failure-isolated-no-effect: Capture and seal artifacts carry proposal_only=true with routing, policy, queue, merge and runtime false. The initial invalid abstention reason failed before record creation and did not alter task state.
validated_acceptance.explicit-terminal-seal: The pilot task was authoritatively observed completed with valid lifecycle evidence, then sealed as abstained with execution status completed and zero semantic assessments; reviewed outcomes now require at least two independent assessments.
validated_acceptance.identity-and-retry-integrity: A later replay with the same task identity returned status=duplicate and binding_status=duplicate while retaining binding_id 6e9df8cc86280b137871f6303ebb1c82e8a56b99eb2ca66edda33c486df5b522 and the original frozen timestamp.
validated_acceptance.contracts-tests-deploy-pilot: PR #452 passed CodeQL plus validation on Python 3.10 and 3.12. The corrective merge deployed successfully with a valid finalization receipt; runtime identity is complete, 174/174 tools match, and the real no-effect pilot is stored as a v3 abstained record.
